Fourth popular-stretchy-mussel plan-repair batch — 2026-09-05

Audited and repaired the next four eligible leaves after excluding the twelve aliases already handled in prior batches. Immutable source basis and clean audit worktree: origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. The four leaves were rechecked open, unassigned, and unsigned immediately before mutation.

- censorious-stinky-tortoise (0302-f5d0-aa57-4d5c): 18 paths, 36 blocks (28 docstrings, 8 comment regions; 4,108 before-words). Split the composite conftest region, removed stale non-prose spans, protected the concise classify/AWS-home blocks, and preserved both literal Terraform marker examples.
- chatty-operatic-marmot (74c1-3bb1-1e4b-4d61): 18 paths, 20 docstrings (1,567 before-words). Rebased the contract onto the retired verify-authorship alias/current verify-identity behavior and added the bridge-vocabulary path consumer; all concise per-test prose remains protected.
- corruptful-dampish-xenops (fe41-8d5e-a17c-4624): 18 paths, 48 blocks (39 docstrings, 9 comment regions; 4,880 before-words). Preserved the current structured_run import seam and bridge status literal, split all later numeric ranges into stable blocks, protected the already-concise full-length-prefix rationale, and recorded unit/interface consumers.
- critical-sand-arrowana (04b9-6bc9-6a75-4c9f): 18 paths, 163 blocks (96 docstrings, 67 comment regions; 10,800 before-words). Replaced every vague “throughout/strongest/ornate banners” scope with an immutable AST/token census, exact per-file counts, deterministic base-only thresholds, and explicit protected exceptions. The current run_detectors name, timing/noqa/type-ignore/pragma directives, translated-shape/forged-attestation docstrings, and concise discovery rationale are outside the allowlist.

Every sub-8k description defines path-qualified D:/C: IDs, immutable before/final ast.parse(..., type_comments=True) comparison, removal of only allowlisted leading docstrings, ast.TypeIgnore.lineno-only normalization, rejection of changed inline/non-allowlisted comments, exact runtime/directive/shebang preservation, and one non-author TSV row per block with immutable full-SHA citations and directives_exact/semantic-preservation/bloat-removal PASS.

Consumer searches covered imports, source/path guards, workflow selectors, __doc__, inspect.getdoc, and pydoc. MCP recorded exact path-specific file impact and exactly five DD commands per leaf: focused pytest with real consumers, scoped Ruff check+format, comment hygiene, owned-path diff check, and worktree-venv make verify.

All 12 leaf writes returned push_status=ok with no description or cross-session warning. Exact MCP readback matched all four descriptions, all 72 path/reason rows, and all 20 command triples. All four remain open, unassigned, and unsigned. No source edit, test/gate/plan review, claim, transition, close, code commit, or manual push occurred; these planning updates and this receipt are normal MCP ticket-event mutations auto-committed and auto-pushed by rebar.
